headline: Microsoft admits October updates did not fix Always On VPN bug
summary: Microsoft confirmed that Always On VPN connection problems were not actually resolved by its October 2026 Windows updates, despite having been marked fixed.

claims.statement: Microsoft's October Windows updates did not actually fix the Always On VPN connection problems.

sources.quote: Microsoft admits that Always On VPN problems were not fixed in the October Security Update
Microsoft says October updates didn’t actually fix VPN issues

claims.statement: Microsoft had mistakenly marked the VPN bug as fixed.

sources.quote: Microsoft says it mistakenly flagged a bug causing Always On VPN connection issues as fixed in the October 2026 Windows 11 cumulative updates.
